subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers review or adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 as the fix for this issue, or close that branch and ask for a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level bug remains, but an open fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a new automated repair lane.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof and resolve the stale check state.

options.title: Request a same-repository replacement
options.body: Close or leave the fork branch aside and ask for a fresh UI-only resolver PR with real Control UI proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof and resolve the stale check state.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the metadata centralization commit that shaped the current resolver/catalog boundary.
